Subject: MerchantCloud — post-demo recap & proposed next steps

Hi Samantha / Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have a single source of truth:

What we heard
- Primary use: in-product conversational search and merchant support triage for chargebacks.
- Target latency: P95 < 300ms for short queries; batch embeddings jobs for nightly reconciliation.
- Data sensitivity: PII in support transcripts; payment card numbers masked at collection layer.

Key stakeholders you mentioned
- Rajiv Patel — VP Operations (economic buyer)
- Samantha Lee — Head of Product (day-to-day eval owner)
- Procurement (procurement@merchantcloud.com) — commercial/contracting
- Security / IT SOC — TBD (please confirm)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Security intake kickoff: we typically collect a top-level network boundary + list of systems in scope, then run through our questionnaire. Can you confirm who on your security side should be on the kickoff and an initial list of systems (e.g., support DB, analytics pipeline, SFTP) by EOD Friday?
2) Procurement path: Rajiv, can you share the procurement timeline and the preferred PO/contracting owner? Any mandatory clauses we should expect?
3) Economic buy-in: if you can confirm decision criteria (cost per seat, latency targets, data residency), we’ll prepare a tailored SLA & price estimate.

I’ve attached a sample network diagram and a quick one-pager on our security posture for context. I’ll loop in our security lead once we have the contact.

Best,
Lauren

Thanks Lauren — nice demo. Quick answers inline: 

> Security kickoff: who should be on the kickoff and list of systems in scope?
We’ll have our Security Engineering lead (I’m looping Rajiv for an intro to that person). Systems in scope for phase 1 are:
- Support transcripts DB (support-db.prod.merchantcloud.internal)
- Payments reconciliation pipeline (airflow & S3 buckets)
- Customer metadata service (metadata-api)

I’m attaching a high-level security summary we keep for partners and a more detailed network diagram.

> Procurement timeline and clauses
Procurement timeline: we typically do a 2-3 week turnaround after final SOW. Procurement contact is procurement@merchantcloud.com (cc’d). Must-haves: standard SOC 2 attestation, data processing addendum (we’ll share our template), and a section on liability caps tied to ARR.

> Decision criteria
Economic buyer is Rajiv — priorities: predictable unit economics, clear isolation for PII workloads, and an easy rollback/fallback path. If you can provide an estimate for a 6‑month pilot (50k tokens/day + nightly embeddings), that would be helpful.

I’ve attached: MerchantCloud_Security_Summary.pdf, merchantcloud_network_diagram_v2.pdf

Thanks for the ping and the context — this looks straightforward for a kickoff. A few notes and next steps from security: 

Short checklist (what we need to kickoff)
- Confirm list of systems in scope (Samantha already listed three; please confirm canonical hostnames/URIs and owner contacts).
- Network boundary diagram (we have merchantcloud_network_diagram_v2.pdf — thanks).
- Data flow for PII and tokenized card data: where masking occurs and who has decryption keys.
- Retention policies for support transcripts and any retention-by-customer features.
- Log access pattern: do we get read-only access to logs or must vendors ship zipped logs for specific windows?

Proposed scoping recommendation
- Phase 1 scope: Support DB + reconciliation pipeline only. Exclude analytics sandbox to reduce approval windows and speed to pilot. We can bring additional services into scope in a Phase 2 review.

Deliverables we will provide
- Intake checklist for MerchantCloud (simple form we prefer: systems, owners, data types, retention, access methods). See link below.
- Pre-filled Redwood security questionnaire (attached as a DOCX) for them to review / redline.
- Proposed controls mapping to their questionnaire for quick win items (we’ll call out SOC 2 controls and data handling notes).

Action items / deadlines
- Samantha: please confirm canonical hostnames and security owner for each listed system by EOD Thu 10/07.
- Procurement: if you can share your contract template and DPA redlines early that helps speed legal review (procurement@merchantcloud.com).
- Ben: can you share the draft pilot estimate by Wed 10/07 EOB so Lauren can present to Rajiv?

Attachments included: redwood_security_questionnaire_2026.docx (fillable), sample_intake_checklist_google_form_link (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Zb9MerchantCloudIntake)
